originStory.title: Why I Created This Masterclass
originStory.story: When Anthropic released the Model Context Protocol in late 2024, I immediately saw its potential. With **10,000+ notes** in my `Obsidian` vault and a **20-year** IT career behind me, I understood exactly what this meant: AI was finally getting the integration layer it desperately needed. No more copy-pasting context. No more being the middleman between AI and my knowledge. I dove deep into `MCP`, tested dozens of servers, figured out what works (and what doesn't), and realized most tutorials were written for developers. Knowledge workers, the people who would benefit most, were being left behind. This masterclass bridges that gap.

creatorJourney.title: Built by a Knowledge Management Expert
creatorJourney.story: I've spent **20+ years** in IT as a Solution Architect and Systems Engineer. But my real passion is knowledge management. I've published **10,000+ notes** publicly, built the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) used by thousands, and created courses teaching people how to organize their digital lives. When `MCP` emerged, I was an early adopter. I've tested the ecosystem extensively, identified the reliable servers, discovered the GUI tools that make setup painless, and mapped out the security considerations most people miss. This masterclass distills months of exploration into a clear path for knowledge workers who want AI superpowers without touching a command line.

before.title: Before MCP
before.description: Every AI interaction started with manual work: copy this note, paste it, copy that file, paste it. Your knowledge was trapped in silos. Websites without APIs were untouchable. You spent more time preparing context than getting answers.

during.title: Learning MCP
during.description: You discover `MCP` isn't as technical as it sounds. GUI tools like `Dockmaster` and `Toolbase` make installation simple. You connect your first server, `Obsidian`, and watch `Claude` read your notes directly. Then web search. Then browser control. Each server multiplies what AI can do.

after.title: After Mastery
after.description: AI becomes your research assistant, workflow automator, and knowledge navigator. You orchestrate cross-tool workflows: AI reads your `Obsidian` notes, searches the web for context, fills forms on sites without APIs. All from a **single prompt**. You think strategically while AI handles the fetching.

methodology.philosophy: Most MCP tutorials are written by developers, for developers. They assume you're comfortable with npm, JSON configs, and command line tools. This masterclass takes a different approach: it's designed for knowledge workers who want results without the technical overhead.
